subtitle: Combinations built only from selections that have value.

empty.never: We never pad a parlay with selections that have no value.

value.title: Value filter on every selection
value.qualified: Qualified selection: its model has beaten the market
value.ev: Positive expected value at the current price
value.interval: A probability without a measured interval is left out, and so is one more than 40 points uncertain
value.books: Every selection quoted by 3 bookmakers or more
value.ai: Every selection went through PrediGol Intelligence; in enforce mode it leaves out what it rejects or downgrades
value.risk: No selection above 3.00: in our history, long odds lose money

independence.title: No related selections
independence.independent: That is why they are treated as independent
independence.perCompetition: At most 2 selections from the same competition
independence.measured: The measured dependence between matches of the same competition and day can only lower the joint probability, never raise it

noPadding.title: No padding
noPadding.body: If there are not enough selections with value, we show no parlay: we never pad.

choice.title: How they are chosen
choice.growth: By expected growth at each selection's cautious probability (the low end of the model's interval)
choice.positive: Built only if that growth is positive, and each added selection has to raise it
choice.frozen: Frozen once built: prices and probabilities do not change afterwards, and it is followed to its result

own.title: Rather build your own?
own.body: Add selections from matches or picks: we check the rules and keep it in My picks.

why.title: Why it's here
why.model: PrediGol gives it {model} (at least {low} in the prudent case); the market, {market}.
why.price: Odds {odds} against a fair price of {fair} ({edge} against fair).
why.evFrozen: Expected value {ev} per unit, at the odds it was taken at.
why.evNow: Expected value {ev} per unit, at today's odds.
why.books_one: Quoted now by {count} bookmaker, no outlier prices.
why.books_other: Quoted now by {count} bookmakers, no outlier prices.
why.noReview: No PrediGol Intelligence review recorded for this selection.

builder.title: Automatic builder
builder.subtitle: Tell us what you are after and PrediGol builds the parlay with the same rules as its own. If there is none worth it, it says so.
builder.noCompetitions: No competitions with selections in this window yet.
builder.hint: Choose what you are after and press “Build parlay”: PrediGol builds it with its rules and explains every selection.

issue.minOdds: The minimum odds must be a number between 1.01 and 1000.
issue.maxOdds: The maximum odds must be a number between 1.01 and 1000.
issue.oddsOrder: The minimum odds cannot be above the maximum.
issue.maxTotal: The maximum total odds must be a number above 1.
issue.legs: The minimum of selections cannot be above the maximum.

result.title: Your parlay
result.pAllHelp: With each selection's prudent probability, corrected for the measured dependence between selections of the same competition and day.
result.shadow: Preview with shadow picks (admin only): not a recommendation.
result.funnel: Of {passing} selections with value in your window, {risk} are priced {max} or less, {reviewed} went through PrediGol Intelligence, {matching} match your filters and {combinable} can be combined ({matches} matches).

why.title: Why this parlay
why.gate: Every selection passes the value filter at today's price: quoted by 3 bookmakers or more, no outlier prices, positive expected value.
why.independent: Different matches and teams, and at most two selections from the same competition.
why.growth: Chosen by expected growth at each selection's prudent probability, not by the highest odds: it is built only if that growth is positive.
why.correlated_one: The measured dependence between selections of the same competition and day lowers the joint probability in {count} pair.
why.correlated_other: The measured dependence between selections of the same competition and day lowers the joint probability in {count} pairs.
why.risk: No selection above odds of {max}: in our history, long odds lose money.
why.context: Every selection went through PrediGol Intelligence, which reviewed its context and the match's news.

builder.loadedToast: Loaded into My parlay: change it if you like and save it from there.
builder.replacedSlip: It replaced the selections you had in My parlay.

none.title: No parlay for these filters
none.no_candidates: Right now no selection passes PrediGol's rules in this window. We do not build parlays from selections that do not pass them.
none.no_match: Some selections pass the rules, but none matches your filters.
none.too_few_legs_one: With your filters there are combinable selections in only {count} match: short of the minimum of {min}.
none.too_few_legs_other: With your filters there are combinable selections in only {count} matches: short of the minimum of {min}.
none.total_odds_cap: With maximum total odds of {cap} there are not {min} selections worth combining.
none.no_growth: There are enough selections, but no combination of {min} or more grows together within the independence rules.
none.risk_cap: Every selection with value in your window pays more than {max}: PrediGol's risk rule leaves them out, because in our history long odds lose money.
none.not_reviewed: The selections with value in your window have not been through PrediGol Intelligence yet: the review runs during the day.

advice.widen: Try a wider window or fewer minimum selections.
advice.filters: Try removing a market, competition or odds filter.
advice.cap: Try raising the maximum total odds or lowering the minimum of selections.
advice.wait: Come back later: prices and selections update during the day.
